rows.definition: The closed classification CUDACoverage (internal/compute) for how a detected CUDA GPU arch maps to the kernels fak was built with: CUDANative (the arch carries native SASS in the build), CUDAJITFromPTX (no SASS but PTX for a lower arch, so kernels JIT at runtime), or CUDAUncovered (neither).
rows.distinction: The per-arch BUILD-SUPPORT classification the serve backend gate reads (cuda_arch_coverage) - NOT the coverage metric (coverage) that scores how much of a declared universe has evidence, NOT unsupportedcoverage (what a release claims is supported), and NOT CUDA device detection/receipts (which report what a live device IS, not whether the build covers its arch).
